Email support

For account, Gmail connection, sending, or billing questions, email{" "} {SUPPORT_EMAIL}. If the link does not open an email app, copy the address into your preferred email service.

What to include

  • The email address you use to sign in to Mailloop.
  • The page you were using and what you were trying to do.
  • The error message and roughly when it happened.

Never include your Google password, sign-in codes, or access tokens. If you attach a screenshot, hide recipient details and private message content.

Privacy and account requests

Use the same support address for privacy, data access, or account deletion questions. Our Privacy Policy{" "} explains how Mailloop handles your information.

Looking for a quick answer? Visit the{" "} Help center for setup steps and common sending questions.
